tasks.gr7-numeric-and-geometric-patterns-t3: Topic: Numeric and geometric patterns. Cover extending sequences, finding missing terms, verbal and symbolic rule descriptions, and geometric growth. Ask Grade 7 learners to identify pattern rules and predict further terms accurately.
tasks.gr7-functions-algebraic-expressions-and-: Topic: Functions, algebraic expressions, and equations. Cover substitution, collecting like terms, translating words to symbols, and solving simple equations. Ask Grade 7 learners to simplify expressions and solve unknowns using balanced reasoning.
tasks.gr7-graphs-t3: Topic: Graphs. Cover ordered pairs, coordinate planes, plotting points, and linking tables to graph representations. Ask Grade 7 learners to read coordinates, interpret trends, and choose accurate graph-based conclusions.
tasks.gr7-transformation-geometry-and-3d-objec: Topic: Transformation geometry and 3D objects. Cover translations, reflections, rotations, enlargements, and classifying solids by faces, edges, and vertices. Ask Grade 7 learners to identify transformations and interpret nets and solid properties.
